{{Vanilla|Diorite}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Diorite''' is a stone that generates in large blobs underground, as in vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] sells it in bulk, lets its polished and slab forms be turned back into the raw stone, and gives its doubled slabs a large-brick look.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Diorite generates as in vanilla.

=== Crafting and smelting ===
{{Recipes}}
Two [[cobblestone]] and two [[quartz]] make 4 diorite, twice the vanilla output; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diorite.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> Two diorite slabs craft back into a block, and a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] turns polished diorite back into diorite (5 seconds).

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 4 [[Bulk blocks|bulk diorite]] for 1 [[obol]] at the novice level; each unpacks into 64 diorite.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/1/diorite.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Diorite is used to make [[andesite]] and [[granite]], as in vanilla. Doubled polished diorite slabs show a large-brick texture, and an upcoming update (not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2-beta]]) gives doubled diorite slabs one too; see [[Large bricks]].
